integrity: The proof is analytic. Finite computation checks only local transfer tables and selected examples and is not used as an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: The sharp order-30 cutoff is asserted only when the type-(iii) core is simple.
The result concerns covers by exactly three perfect matchings and does not resolve four-cover existence.
Older Tait-colouring literature may contain an equivalent multiplicative counting rule under different terminology; targeted searches did not locate one.
title: Exact three-perfect-matching cover counts for bridgeless claw-free cubic graphs
